args.title: Synthetic live canary: canonical_label normalization and ASCII validation
args.body: Draft synthetic live-canary PR containing both authorized tasks. Task 1 normalizes ASCII case and whitespace. Task 2 rejects non-ASCII input with ValueError while retaining Task 1 behavior. Four focused unittest regressions passed locally in the confined worker. No production, jobpipe, Sonary, accounts, or application changes.
